fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor inlined in the fighter boma builder f_71006882d0 (near 0x710068b044) stores vptr 0x7104f73420 and stores the object at boma+0x160. One class (fighter only). Destructors f_71004c7e20 / f_71004c7e80.

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Stored with the vptr. Methods reach PostureModule [+0x8]+0x38, StatusModule +0x40, GroundModule +0x58, ModelModule +0x78, PhysicsModule +0x80, MotionModule +0x88, StopModule +0x90, LinkModule +0xD0.

fields.name: requested_kind_mask
fields.evidence: Unexported getter vtable +0x50 (f_71004c8a60) returns it. update (vtable +0x60), reset (+0x38) and slot +0x68 copy the pending request's mask here. Bits: 0 = body slope angle, 1 = left-foot adjust, 2 = right-foot adjust, 3 = rotate the 'top' model joint (from the pair fields and joints each bit drives). Initial 0.

fields.name: active_kind_mask
fields.evidence: Slot +0x58 (f_71004c8a70, set_enable(bool)) writes requested_kind_mask or 0 here and the bool at +0xC1; update re-applies it after taking a request. update tests bit0 (grounded slope), bit1/bit2 (foot adjust) here. Initial 0.

fields.name: unknown_18
fields.evidence: Zeroed by the constructor and by setup (vtable +0x28, 128-bit zero of +0x10..+0x1F); no reader found among the class's methods.

fields.name: request_list.vptr
fields.evidence: Embedded fixed-capacity list object: constructor stores vptr 0x7104f734d8 here, capacity 1 at +0x28, size 0 at +0x30, data pointer = this+0x40 at +0x38; destructor restores base vptr 0x7104f73508 and zeroes +0x38.

fields.name: request_list.capacity
fields.evidence: Constructor writes 1; never changed.

fields.name: request_list.count
fields.evidence: request (vtable +0x48, f_71004c8a10) resets it to 0 when nonzero, writes one entry and sets it to 1; update/reset consume the entry and write 0. Initial 0.

fields.name: request_list.data
fields.evidence: Constructor points it at this+0x40 (inline storage).

fields.type: struct{u32 mask; i32 frames; u8 use_line_change_frames}
fields.name: pending_request
fields.evidence: request(mask, frames, bool) stores mask & ~disabled_kind_mask (+0x98) at +0x40, frames at +0x44, bool at +0x48 (ignored if bit0 is set together with bit1/bit2). When consumed: mask -> requested_kind_mask; if the bool is set, frames -> line_change_blend_frames (+0x6C); otherwise, for each bit that changed, frames -> the matching blend pair. Initial 0.

fields.name: slope_angle
fields.evidence: Unexported getter vtable +0x90 (f_71004ca0c0) returns it. update computes the ground angle in degrees (atan2 of GroundModule normal / line points times 180/pi, clamped to +-max_slope_angle unless +0xC0) and moves it: angle += (target - angle) / (body_blend_left + 1). Off the ground or when not in situation 0 it is set directly. Applied by f_71004ca0f0 as PostureModule rotation z (index +0x8C) and, with kind bit3, as a rotation of the 'top' joint (ModelModule vtable +0x1A0). Initial 0.

fields.name: body_blend (total, left)
fields.evidence: Request bit0 or a ground-line change writes the frame count to both +0x54 and +0x58; update decrements +0x58 each frame and zeroes +0x54 when it reaches 0; used as divisor for slope_angle smoothing. Initial 0.

fields.name: left_foot_blend (total, left)
fields.evidence: Request bit1 writes frames to +0x5C and +0x60; update decrements +0x60; the ratio left/total weights the left-foot adjustment passed to PhysicsModule (vtable +0x1D0, joint index +0xBC). Initial 0.

fields.name: right_foot_blend (total, left)
fields.evidence: Same as left with bit2 and joint index +0xBD. Initial 0.

fields.name: line_change_blend_frames
fields.evidence: Set from a request with its bool; when the ground line under the fighter changes and body_blend left < this value, update restarts body_blend with it. Initial 0.

fields.name: ground_line
fields.evidence: update stores the current ground collision line found through GroundModule (vtable +0x408/+0x520) and compares it with the previous one (line byte +0x100 must be set); zeroed when airborne. Initial 0.

fields.name: ground_line_ref (ptr, ctrl)
fields.evidence: update copies a (ptr, control block) pair here, incrementing the weak count (+0x10 of the control block) and releasing the old one with std::__shared_weak_count::__release_weak; destructor zeroes +0x70/+0x78 and releases +0x80. Initial 0.

fields.name: max_slope_angle
fields.evidence: Setup (vtable +0x28, f_71004c8190) stores its first float argument; update clamps the target angle to +-this unless +0xC0. Initial 0.

fields.name: posture_rot_index
fields.evidence: Passed as the rotation index to PostureModule rot (vtable +0xD8) and set_rot (vtable +0xE0) by f_71004ca0f0. Zeroed by constructor and setup; no other writer found.

fields.name: top_joint
fields.evidence: Constructor and setup store Hash40 0x031ed91fca ('top', ParamLabels); unexported setter vtable +0x80 (f_71004ca0a0) overwrites it. Joint rotated through ModelModule vtable +0x1A0 by f_71004ca0f0 and when linked.

fields.name: disabled_kind_mask
fields.evidence: Unexported setter vtable +0x88 (f_71004ca0b0); request masks its kind bits with ~this. Initial 0.

fields.name: floor_diff_l
fields.evidence: floor_diff_l (vtable +0x98, f_71004ca0d0) returns the f32 here. update zeroes +0x9C/+0xA0 at entry and, for the left foot, stores (floor height under the foot point from GroundModule vtable +0x5B8 ray, projected with cos/sin of +0xB0) minus the PostureModule pos y.

fields.name: floor_diff_r
fields.evidence: floor_diff_r (vtable +0xA0, f_71004ca0e0) returns the f32 here; computed by update for the right foot like floor_diff_l. Bytes 0xA4..0xA7 padding.

fields.name: leg_params
fields.evidence: Setup stores its pointer argument. Block layout used: +0x0 / +0x4 u32 physics joint indices (copied to +0xBC/+0xBD by reset), +0x10/+0x18/+0x20/+0x28 joint Hash40s (ModelModule vtable +0x150 lookups for foot positions; MotionModule vtable +0x4E0 tests +0x18/+0x28 to fill +0xC2/+0xC3). If null, the foot-joint parts are skipped.

fields.name: foot_ray_angle_rad
fields.evidence: Setup stores it; update uses cosf/sinf of +-this to project the foot points when computing floor_diff_l/r.

fields.name: setup_param_3
fields.evidence: Setup stores its third float argument; no reader found among the class's methods.

fields.name: setup_param_4
fields.evidence: Setup stores its fourth float argument; no reader found among the class's methods.

fields.name: foot_joint_index (left, right)
fields.evidence: Reset (vtable +0x38, f_71004c88a0) copies leg_params+0x0 / +0x4 here (0 if no params); update passes them sign-extended to PhysicsModule vtable +0x1D0 / +0x1D8.

fields.name: foot_adjust_done (left, right)
fields.evidence: update sets +0xBE / +0xBF when the left / right blend weight reaches 0 with the kind bit active, and clears them after calling PhysicsModule vtable +0x1D8; reset and off-ground paths zero both.

fields.name: no_angle_limit
fields.evidence: Unexported setter vtable +0x78 (f_71004ca090, arg&1); when set update skips the max_slope_angle clamp. Reset writes 0. Initial 0.

fields.name: enable
fields.evidence: Set by set_enable (vtable +0x58) together with active_kind_mask; constructor and setup write 1.

fields.name: has_foot_joint (left, right)
fields.evidence: Reset stores MotionModule vtable +0x4E0 results for leg_params+0x18 / +0x28; update chooses which joint hash to use for each foot from them. Initial 0. Bytes 0xC4..0xC7 padding.

pointers.to: weak_ptr to the ground line (ptr, control block)
per-fighter leg slope params (joint indices, joint hashes)

notes: Vtable 21 entries: +0x18 event handler; +0x28 setup(leg_params, max_angle, ray_angle_deg, p3, p4) also registers a 0x28-byte listener; +0x30 unregister; +0x38 reset; +0x48 request(mask, frames, bool); +0x50 requested_kind_mask; +0x58 set_enable; +0x60 update(bool) (large: when LinkModule vtable +0x448(-1) is true it only rotates the top joint from the link; else processes the request, smooths slope_angle, foot adjust, floor diffs); +0x68 apply request now; +0x70 update_model_top_angle export (f_71004c9f40: recomputes the ground angle when grounded and rotates the top joint); +0x78/+0x80/+0x88 setters; +0x90 slope_angle; +0x98/+0xA0 floor_diff_l/r. Several angle computations go through GOT imports atan2f, sinf, cosf. Semantic names for the kind bits are inferred from the blend pairs and joints they drive.
